title: Terminate Choppe's Contract
description: Terminate Choppe's Contract — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Nielsen

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to Choppe's Shoppe located on the seventh level of Frump's Misfortune and kill Dr. Richard Choppe, 30 Divine Whisker Shamans, and Divine Whisker Blademasters. Report to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when finished.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Nielsen

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Terminate Jaym'zz's Contract

Zone: Frump's Misfortune

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Choppe's Shoppe located on the seventh level of Frump's Misfortune and kill Dr. Richard Choppe, 30 Divine Whisker Shamans, and Divine Whisker Blademasters. Report to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort when finished.

Offer:

We are having a contract dispute that we would like for you to help us resolve. Dr. Richard Choppe and his team called the South Littoral Choppers have become unresponsive in our negotiations. Richard's ego has been horribly inflated and he is asking for more royalties. The show itself hasn't done all that great, but his Littoral Chopper weaponry product line has been a hit.

Richard Choppe became famous due to his metal working skills and for swords bearing his moniker. For some reason, his customers think it's humorous to wield swords with his name on the side.

His ego is asking for us to add dolls or action figures as he calls them to the product line. We don't think that Dungeon Runners will be interested in little dolls named Little Richard Choppe or any dolls named after his Littoral Chopper crew members.

He wants to kill his contract and draw up another one. In the fine print of his contract it states that should he meet his demise, all rights and ownerships default back to the network.

Head into Choppe's Shoppe to kill Richard Choppe's ego and then convince him he doesn't wish to renegotiate. Convince Dr. Choppe that he wants to continue working with us as a team. If he or any one of his crew members has a problem with the new deal, then you can show them your skills in contract negotiations. After the contract has been taken care of, let Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort know that it's been taken care of.

Turn-in:

Thank you for changing his mind. We have one final thorn in our side that needs to be let go. When you are ready for a fireball shootout with Je'zzee James, let me know. We have a contract out on him.

Objectives:

  • Dr. Richard Choppe
  • Divine Whisker Blade Masters
  • Divine Whisker Shamans

Client level range: 40–45
